president-and-vice-president.note: Counted by ranked choice (21-A MRS section 723-A); the votes shown are first choices. The leader had more than half of the first choices for the candidates and write-ins, a majority no later round could take away, so the leader is marked elected. Maine chooses two presidential electors statewide and one in each congressional district.

representative-to-congress-2.note: Its counties are those of the municipalities the statewide tabulations print and District 1's does not. Counted by ranked choice. The Secretary of State's central count (RCV Summary Report) needed one round: Jared Forrest Golden 197,151, Austin Theriault 194,445 of 391,596 continuing ballots (402,936 ballots in all, the rest exhausted: blank, overvoted or for a write-in); Jared Forrest Golden had more than half and won.
